summary: Every changed file was read and nothing reachable was found. The change does alter one observable refusal, and whether that was intended is a decision the code cannot state, so it is recorded as a question rather than a defect.

questions.question: Is the stricter refusal of a rule set that matches nothing a deliberate change, or a side effect of tightening the matcher?
questions.why_material: Configurations that previously passed now fail closed. Nothing in the diff, the tests or the contracts says which behaviour is wanted, so only the author can settle it; a reviewer that guessed would be inventing a requirement.
